note: Hand-picked hyperparameters/results from 'Attention Is All You Need' (Vaswani et al. 2017, arXiv:1706.03762). Matched against text as extracted by pypdf and whitespace-normalized (subscripts like d_model extract as 'dmodel' with no underscore - facts are spelled to match the extractor, not the typeset PDF).
extraction: pypdf PdfReader.extract_text() per page, joined, then re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text)
